verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an official TypeScript SDK for building pieces and an SDK for embedding/customizing the platform, plus a REST API with API-key/Bearer auth, all of which an AI-native developer could build against. However, no official OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s across common paths) and there's no evidence of official multi-language client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS API wrapper) beyond the embedding/piece-building SDKs. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/swagger spec, dedicated API client SDKs in multiple languages, independent developer corroboration of SDK quality.
